I have been farming this small piece of land for many years, and I know what my soil needs. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or those expensive new seeds from the market, but I have my chickens and goats, so I spread their manure on the soil before planting to give the maize strength. My children and grandchildren will help me clear the land, plant, weed, and harvest with our own hands — we cannot afford to pay hired workers. The rains will come as they always do in our area, so I do not need to carry water for irrigation, and I pull the weeds myself rather than buying costly chemicals.
